uncited: Builds on the chunk-based spatial partitioning family [Chunk-based spatial partitioning](3862-chunk-based-spatial-partitioning.md).
Early implementations used simple slice-based decomposition across MPI processes [MPI-based Volume Partitioning](1093-mpi-based-volume-partitioning.md).

Subsequent research introduced graph-partitioning techniques for unstructured grids to minimize communication during rendering [Object-space decomposition with local clustering](4156-object-space-decomposition-with-local-clustering.md).

More recently, high-level abstractions like ShardedVolume have been developed to manage distributed volumetric data for scientific computing and machine learning workloads [ShardedVolume](12593-shardedvolume.md).
